[package]
name = "deckcraft-color"
version = "0.10.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "DeckCraft colour: RGB/HSL, theme colour slots, DrawingML-style colour transforms"

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
todo = "warn"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
self_named_constructors = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
result_large_err = "allow"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[package]
name = "deckcraft-geom"
version = "0.10.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "DeckCraft geometry: units (EMU/pt), transforms, preset shape generators, adjust handles, hit testing"

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
todo = "warn"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
self_named_constructors = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
result_large_err = "allow"

[dependencies.kurbo]
version = "0.13"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[package]
name = "deckcraft-model"
version = "0.10.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "DeckCraft document model: presentations, masters, layouts, slides, shapes, text, themes, transitions, animations"

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
todo = "warn"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
self_named_constructors = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
result_large_err = "allow"

[dependencies]
thiserror = "2"
unicode-segmentation = "1"

[dependencies.deckcraft-geom]
path = "crates/geom"

[dependencies.deckcraft-color]
path = "crates/color"

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1"
features = ["derive", "rc"]

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["float_roundtrip"]

[package]
name = "deckcraft-pptx"
version = "0.10.0"
edition = "2024"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
description = "DeckCraft PPTX: Office Open XML (PresentationML/DrawingML) import and export, written from the public ECMA-376 standard"

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"

[lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "warn"
todo = "warn"
too_many_arguments = "allow"
type_complexity = "allow"
self_named_constructors = "allow"
large_enum_variant = "allow"
result_large_err = "allow"

[dependencies]
quick-xml = "0.41"
thiserror = "2"
log = "0.4"

[dependencies.deckcraft-model]
path = "crates/model"

[dependencies.deckcraft-geom]
path = "crates/geom"

[dependencies.deckcraft-color]
path = "crates/color"

[dependencies.zip]
version = "3"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]

[dev-dependencies.deckcraft-engine]
path = "crates/engine"

[dev-dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1"
features = ["float_roundtrip"]

[dev-dependencies.deckcraft-color]
path = "crates/color"

[dev-dependencies.deckcraft-geom]
path = "crates/geom"

[dev-dependencies.image]
version = "0.25"
default-features = false
features = ["png", "jpeg", "webp", "gif", "tiff", "bmp"]

[dev-dependencies.zip]
version = "3"
default-features = false
features = ["deflate"]
